title: Realtor.com ZIP-level inventory core metrics - Hawaii ZIPs (967xx/968xx)

source.publisher: Realtor.com Economic Research (public S3 bucket econdata)

source.place_names: zip_name column in the Realtor.com file (USPS primary city)
source.island_mapping: GeoNames US ZIP table county field (Honolulu->Oahu, Kauai, Maui/Kalawao->Maui County, Hawaii->Hawaii Island), cross-checked against a primary-city->island hand table (no conflicts unless listed in gaps); Molokai/Lanai split within Maui County by primary city

source.benchmarks: REALTOR_PUBLISHED_aggregate blocks come from RDC_Inventory_Core_Metrics_County_History.csv (FIPS 15003 Honolulu=Oahu, 15009 Maui excl. Kalawao, 15007 Kauai, 15001 Hawaii) and _State_History.csv (Hawaii); these are Realtor.com's true county/state aggregates and should be preferred over the ZIP-based APPROX price figures.

notes: Realtor.com metrics cover active for-sale listings on Realtor.com (all property types combined: single-family, condo/townhome, etc.); they are LISTING metrics, not closed sales.

Median listing price is the median asking price of active listings in the ZIP for the month. Island/state rollup prices here are APPROXIMATIONS: (a) active-listing-weighted mean of ZIP medians and (b) active-listing-weighted median of ZIP medians. They are NOT true medians of all listings; use Realtor.com county/metro files for exact aggregates.

price_reduced_share_agg = sum(price_reduced_count)/sum(active_listing_count); pending_ratio_agg = sum(pending_listing_count)/sum(active_listing_count). Realtor.com's own pending_ratio = pending/active at ZIP level (verify per ZIP).

In the Sep-2026 current-month file, every Hawaii ZIP new_listing_count and price_reduced_count value is an even number (83/83), indicating Realtor.com rounding/noise at ZIP level; small counts are approximate. Published price_reduced_share and pending_ratio do not exactly equal count/active (computed by Realtor.com on underlying data) - use the published share per ZIP; the *_agg rollups are count-based approximations.
thin_lt10_active = active_listing_count < 10 in that month; treat ZIP medians and shares as unreliable.

quality_flag is reported as published by Realtor.com (1 = flagged by Realtor.com; per Realtor.com, flagged rows may reflect data-source changes and should be interpreted with caution). Blank = not flagged/not provided.
History file values are as-revised in the 2026-09-30 release; Sep-2025 and Sep-2019 values may differ from originally published monthly files.
Only ZIPs present in Realtor.com data are included (~83 of Hawaii's ZIPs; PO-box/military/tiny ZIPs absent or intermittent). Missing month for a ZIP = null.

Price tiers applied to ZIP median listing prices (standard tiers: entry <$750K; mid $750K-1.5M; upper $1.5M-3M; luxury $3M-10M; ultra >=$10M). This classifies ZIPs, not individual listings; listing-level tier counts are not available from this source (gap).
No owner names or street addresses are present in this source.
gaps: No property-type split (house vs condo) in Realtor.com ZIP core metrics.
No listing-level price-tier counts ($1M+/$5M+ listings) in this source; only ZIP-median tier classification.

Oahu Sep-2019 pending counts are effectively missing in Realtor.com data (ZIP pending sum = 1; Honolulu County published pending_ratio 0.0016), so Oahu and All-Hawaii pending ratios for 2019 are NOT comparable to 2025/2026.
Kauai price-reduced counts are near zero in most Kauai ZIPs (published Kauai County share 4.8% in Sep-2026 vs 13.1% Sep-2025); likely feed coverage - interpret Kauai price-reduced share with caution.
Realtor.com quality_flag=1 on 36 of 83 Hawaii ZIP rows in Sep-2026 (mostly small ZIPs).
Resort enclaves (e.g., Wailea, Kaanapali, Kohala Coast, Poipu) are not separable from their ZIPs (96753 Kihei, 96761 Lahaina, 96743 Kamuela/96738 Waikoloa, 96756 Koloa).
